highlights: A one-tap watering now records a normal water amount, so it counts in the plant's water record
Saving a harvest waits longer on a weak signal instead of giving up early
The plant picker shows the real sowing day; it was showing the day before
Put-up: a put-up picked from the Pantry for a batch can be taken off that batch, with Undo, so a batch closed that way can be removed
Put-up: a change you make after a lost connection is kept when you save again
Adding a plant on a seed lot's page puts a Seed saved entry on that plant's timeline
A bought seed blend is no longer tagged Your mix
The Release Notes dot stays cleared after you have read the notes on another device
